newsitem.title: FRANCE: Peugeot drags French company fcasts down mid-May.
newsitem.headline: Peugeot drags French company fcasts down mid-May.

text.p: French corporate research survey group Associes en Finance said it had registered in mid-May a 0.2 percent downward revision among equity research houses for 1997 earnings per share among a sample of 150 French companies.
But the revision had been heavily influenced by drastic changes in Peugeot forecasts and if this factor was stripped out the trend was reversed, Associes en Finance said.
On average, the downward revision was to the tune of 1.9 percent for companies in the CAC-40 leading share index, it said.
But with Peugeot excluded, this turned into an upward revision of 0.3 percent for CAC-40 firms and to the tune of 0.4 percent for the total corporate sample, it said.
